#!/usr/bin/env python3
import socket, select, time, re, sys

LOG_PATH = '/tmp/setup_alpine.log'
log = open(LOG_PATH, 'wb', 0)
def w(b):
    log.write(b); log.flush()

s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/alpine-serial.sock')
s.setblocking(False)

buf = b''

def pump(sec):
    global buf
    end = time.time() + sec
    while time.time() < end:
        try:
            r, _, _ = select.select([s], [], [], min(0.5, max(0, end - time.time())))
        except InterruptedError:
            continue
        if r:
            try:
                d = s.recv(65536)
            except BlockingIOError:
                continue
            if not d:
                break
            buf += d
            w(d)
            if len(buf) > 800000:
                buf = buf[-300000:]
    return buf

def expect(pattern, timeout, label=''):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    rx = re.compile(pattern, re.I)
    while time.time() < end:
        m = rx.search(buf.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
        if m:
            return m
        pump(0.5)
    raise TimeoutError('timeout waiting for %r (%s); tail=%r' % (
        pattern, label, buf[-1500:]))

def send(text):
    global buf
    w(('\n>>> ' + text.replace('\r', '\\r') + '\n').encode())
    s.sendall(text.encode())

def cmd(command, timeout=180, label=None):
    tag = 'T%d%s' % (int(time.time() * 1000) % 1000000, (label or '')[:20].replace(' ', '_'))
    send(command + '; echo "%s:$?"\r' % tag)
    m = expect(re.escape(tag) + r':(\d+)', timeout, label or command[:50])
    return int(m.group(1))

def step(msg):
    w(('\n===== %s =====\n' % msg).encode())

try:
    step('waiting for login prompt')
    expect(r'login:', 1500, 'login prompt')
    global buf
    buf = b''
    send('root\r')
    pump(5)
    if b'assword:' in buf:
        step('login asks for password; sending empty password')
        send('\r')
        pump(3)
    rc = cmd('echo LOGIN_OK', 120, 'login')
    step('logged in (rc=%d)' % rc)

    step('configure network')
    rc = cmd('IF=$(ls /sys/class/net | grep -vx lo | head -n1); '
             'echo IFACE=$IF; ip link set "$IF" up; '
             'ip addr replace 10.0.2.15/24 dev "$IF"; '
             'ip route replace default via 10.0.2.2; ip -4 addr show dev "$IF"',
             120, 'net')
    w(('network rc=%d\n' % rc).encode())

    step('check apk repositories')
    cmd('cat /etc/apk/repositories; echo ---; mount | grep -i "cdrom\\|iso9660"',
        60, 'repo')

    step('install openssh from ISO repo')
    rc = cmd('apk add openssh', 900, 'apk')
    w(('apk rc=%d\n' % rc).encode())
    if rc != 0 or cmd('command -v /usr/sbin/sshd >/dev/null', 30, 'chksshd') != 0:
        step('apk add failed; trying manual CD mount')
        cmd('mkdir -p /media/cdrom; mount -t iso9660 -o ro /dev/sr0 /media/cdrom 2>&1; '
            'ls /media/cdrom/apks | head -3', 120, 'mountcd')
        rc = cmd('echo /media/cdrom/apks > /etc/apk/repositories; apk add openssh',
                 900, 'apk2')
        w(('apk retry rc=%d\n' % rc).encode())

    step('set root password')
    buf = b''
    send('passwd root\r')
    expect(r'new password:', 60, 'new password')
    send('password123\r')
    expect(r'retype password:|new password:', 60, 'retype password')
    send('password123\r')
    expect(r'password for root changed|passwd:|changing password', 120, 'changed')
    cmd('echo PASSWD_DONE', 60, 'passwd done')

    step('configure sshd')
    rc = cmd('mkdir -p /run/sshd; '
             'mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d; '
             "printf 'PermitRootLogin yes\\nPasswordAuthentication yes\\nPermitEmptyPasswords no\\n' "
             '> /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-root.conf; '
             'ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null 2>&1; /usr/sbin/sshd -t; echo SSHD_T=$?',
             120, 'sshdcfg')
    w(('sshd -t rc=%d\n' % rc).encode())

    step('start sshd')
    cmd('rc-update add sshd default 2>&1; rc-service sshd start 2>&1; sleep 2; '
        '(netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null || ss -lnt) | grep -E "[:.]22[[:space:]]" ; '
        'echo LISTEN_CHECK=$?', 180, 'startsshd')
    cmd('rc-service sshd status 2>&1; /usr/sbin/sshd -T 2>/dev/null | '
        'grep -Ei "^(permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|port) "', 120, 'status')

    step('final verification')
    cmd('echo SSH_PROC=$(pgrep -c sshd); uname -a; cat /etc/alpine-release', 60, 'final')
    step('SETUP_COMPLETE')
finally:
    try:
        s.close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    log.close()
